inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL expression converts binary IPv6 data into canonical text with INET6_NTOA.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one fixed hexadecimal IPv6 value passed through UNHEX and INET6_NTOA so function recognition and canonical rendering are isolated from table state and report logic.

fixture_notes: One documentation IPv6 address isolates binary-to-text conversion and VARCHAR result metadata without schema setup or multiple rows.
determinism_notes: The hexadecimal address is fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
